scope: Definitions and physical quantities used by the repaired proposed Thermodynamics prose. This records the declared model, type, frame, units and differentiability restrictions; it does not certify empirical applicability or future page publication.

framework_terms.definition: A declared material model with r named chemical species and a specified admitted equilibrium domain; absent-species boundaries and reaction channels are separately declared.
framework_terms.domain: A particular composition/state model.

framework_terms.definition: A physically specified subset of the SI coordinate space (U,V,n_1,...,n_r) with an admitted-preparation set E_c and representation map pi_c:E_c->D_c. Not every coordinate point is assumed physically realizable.
framework_terms.domain: Declared equilibrium preparations for constitution c.

framework_terms.definition: A specified nonempty open convex subset of the (U,V) slice at fixed n, with V>0; derivative formulas apply only on explicitly stated smooth subcharts.
framework_terms.domain: One fixed composition and material model.

framework_terms.term: ordinary stable additive bulk simple-compressible model
framework_terms.definition: A restricted model label: stable means global entropy maximizer on the declared feasible set; additive means exact sum rules after declared interface/long-range terms are neglected; bulk means a tagged scaling family with a declared homogeneity postulate; simple compressible means volume is the only mechanical generalized coordinate and adopted reversible work is -p dV.
framework_terms.domain: Only the principal positive-temperature equilibrium route.
framework_terms.status: defined model class, not universal taxonomy

framework_terms.definition: A preparation is a rule selecting an initial state or probability law. The representation map pi_c assigns its thermodynamic coordinate x. Equilibrium is stable only relative to the declared constraints and allowed transformations.
framework_terms.domain: Declared state and preparation spaces.

framework_terms.definition: Tuple (I_P,x_P^-,x_P^+,z_P,c_P,r_P), where I_P=[t_0,t_1] has time in seconds, endpoints lie in D_c, z records system/auxiliaries/devices in a model-declared configuration space, c records controls/contacts, and r records signed, unit-typed boundary transfers. Intermediate states need not be equilibria.
framework_terms.domain: Admitted record set chosen by a model.

framework_terms.definition: Closed forbids matter transfer across the chosen system boundary; open permits only named matter fluxes; isolated forbids all external matter and energy exchange for the compound; adiabatic means exactly Q[P]=0 under the stated heat assignment.
framework_terms.domain: System boundary and process record.

framework_terms.definition: Reversible means an admitted reverse record returns auxiliaries/devices to their initial states and reverses boundary transfers. Quasistatic path means a piecewise-C1 equilibrium curve generated by a declared limiting protocol. Neither slow evolution nor quasistaticity alone implies reversibility.
framework_terms.domain: Declared device boundary and protocol class.

framework_terms.term: first-law transfer maps Q and W_on
framework_terms.definition: Protocol-dependent maps on the admitted closed record set; Q>0 is heat into the system and W_on>0 is work on it. In the stated class Delta U=Q+W_on. Transfers are not state functions.
framework_terms.domain: Closed records with center-of-mass kinetic and external-potential energy changes fixed to zero.

framework_terms.definition: Bath b has open energy interval U_b, entropy S_b in C1 with S_b' >0, and T_b=1/S_b'. An ideal bath holds T_b fixed by an infinite-capacity or regulated idealization; a finite bath need not.
framework_terms.domain: Named bath model and declared heat coupling.

framework_terms.definition: x~_T y iff the declared diathermal contact preparation has equilibrium with no permitted net heat transfer; equivalence is an adopted zeroth-law postulate and alone gives no real temperature coordinate.
framework_terms.domain: Declared family of material states and contacts.

framework_terms.definition: Finite, continuous, concave fundamental relation on specified convex regions, additive for independent separated bodies under declared interface neglect and homogeneous on an explicitly tagged bulk-scaling family. C2 on smooth single-phase open regions and S_U>0 only where stated.
framework_terms.domain: Declared equilibrium domain; no automatic extension to boundaries or nonsmooth coexistence charts.
framework_terms.status: primitive physical postulate in the principal route

framework_terms.term: temperature T, pressure p, chemical potential mu_j
framework_terms.definition: On a C1 entropy chart with S_U>0, T=1/S_U, p=T S_V, mu_j=-T S_nj, with derivatives at fixed remaining coordinates. Identifying p with force/area additionally uses the adopted frictionless piston coupling; other generalized forces need separate couplings.
framework_terms.domain: Smooth local chart, fixed variable conventions and positive finite T.
framework_terms.status: derived state functions; mechanical identification is conditional

framework_terms.definition: n_j is amount of substance in mol, N_j is a dimensionless particle count, n_j=N_j/N_A, and mu_j^(particle)=mu_j/N_A; thus mu_j=N_A mu_j^(particle).
framework_terms.domain: Declared species and amount/count conversion.

framework_terms.definition: The equilibrium claim is attainment of a global maximum of total entropy on the exact feasible set fixed by conserved totals and retained partitions. Existence/compactness must be established or adopted. Local maxima/metastable preparations require separate dynamical scope.
framework_terms.domain: Each declared contact, reaction, partition and composition-exchange permissions.

framework_terms.definition: A phase is a specified branch of homogeneous equilibrium preparations with declared regularity. Coexistence is an admissible mixture of named branches attaining the global entropy maximum for stated totals/constraints. Equal intensive variables follow only for corresponding allowed interior exchanges.
framework_terms.domain: Specified phase branches and feasible mixture set.

framework_terms.term: molar Gibbs potential and Clapeyron slope
framework_terms.definition: For one-component bulk phase i, g_i=G_i/n_i in J/mol with n_i>0 and G=U-TS+pV. Under a common C1 coexistence chart with Delta v !=0, g_a=g_b yields dp/dT=Delta s/Delta v, where v=V/n and s=S/n.
framework_terms.domain: Smooth branch charts, interface neglect, and stated coexistence conditions.

framework_terms.definition: A declared sequence of volumes/particle numbers and interactions/boundaries with specified intensive limit, together with a stated entropy/free-energy density limit. Existence, equivalence of ensembles and derivative interchange require the named model-specific theorem.
framework_terms.domain: Only the exact shapes/interactions/limits in the supplying contract.

framework_terms.definition: For D_+ the positive-temperature equilibrium domain and compact fixed-constraint parameter set K, an equilibrium map phi:(0,T0)xK->D_+ with T(phi(t,a))=t is given and sup_(a,b)|S(phi(t,a))-S(phi(t,b))|->0 as t down to zero is an additional uniform postulate. S_K(0,a) is defined only when the finite limit exists.
framework_terms.domain: Declared family and limit convention.

framework_terms.definition: Declare a nonempty zero-temperature equilibrium preparation set D_0 disjoint from D_+, the augmented space Dbar=D_+ disjoint-union D_0, and an extended map Tbar:Dbar->[0,infinity) with Tbar|D_+=T and Tbar=0 on D_0. For an explicitly declared protocol family C, Reach_C contains endpoint pairs joined by a finite chain of admitted operations with total duration tau finite in seconds; unattainability is Reach_C intersect (D_+ x D_0)=empty. With no D_0 or if protocols are constrained to stay in D_+, the statement is absent or vacuous.
framework_terms.domain: Only the stated operation family and state endpoints.
framework_terms.status: separate physical postulate; not equivalent to Nernst without further assumptions

framework_terms.definition: For finite ground-state degeneracy g (dimension of the ground eigenspace), k_B log g is a model-specific residual entropy only if the declared canonical low-temperature limit and entropy convention yield it.
framework_terms.domain: Specified microscopic model and limiting preparation.

framework_terms.term: finite statistical-mechanical state and canonical preparation
framework_terms.definition: A finite state set or Hilbert-space model, energy-valued observable in the specified frame, and explicit preparation rule. Quantum Gibbs state rho_beta=e^(-beta H)/Z requires self-adjoint H, beta>0, and positive trace-class e^(-beta H) with 0<Z<infinity. Canonical sampling is adopted from extra bath/maximum-entropy assumptions; it is not derived from macroscopic laws alone.
framework_terms.domain: Exact finite or trace-class model hypotheses; no inferred equilibration.

framework_terms.definition: For measurable energy H on (X,F,m), shell {x:E<=H(x)<E+Delta} with E,Delta in J and Delta>0; normalized shell measure requires finite nonzero mass and a stated uniform-weight/preparation convention.
framework_terms.domain: Declared state-space measure and shell resolution.

framework_terms.term: local-equilibrium heat field and Fourier flux
framework_terms.definition: On declared spatial domain D subset R3 and time interval I, fields T:DxI->(0,infinity), u:DxI->R and j_Q:DxI->R3 require stated regularity and boundary/initial data. u is energy density and j_Q heat flux; j_Q=-K grad T is an additional constitutive postulate for declared conductivity tensor K.
framework_terms.domain: Conditional continuum branch; no global PDE existence or Navier-Stokes viscous-heating claim.

framework_terms.definition: For r species, reaction matrix nu in R^(r x R) of rank R, P phases, common T,p, r-1 independent composition coordinates per phase, PR independent in-phase reaction-affinity constraints, and (P-1)(r-R) independent equalities of conserved-component potentials, full row rank of the combined constraint Jacobian yields local intensive dimension 2+r-P-R by the implicit-rank theorem. Phase amounts are separate extensive variables.
framework_terms.domain: Positive mole fractions, smooth phase branches and common coexistence chart; no extra fields or boundary constraints.

quantities.meaning: internal energy; excluded bulk translation and external-field potential in principal route
quantities.frame: center-of-mass rest frame; model-fixed energy zero including stated rest-energy offsets
declared SI absolute calibration; not dimensionless LY normalization

quantities.meaning: heat into system and work done on system for record P

quantities.frame: Galilean scalar in declared center-of-mass rest-frame model; positive finite chart

quantities.meaning: T S_V; conditionally identified with mechanical wall pressure
heat capacities at declared fixed coordinates
quantities.frame: valid local chart; C_p definition via H at fixed p,n

quantities.meaning: isothermal compressibility and volume expansion coefficient
enthalpy U+pV; Helmholtz U-TS; Gibbs U-TS+pV; grand potential U-TS-Sum mu_j n_j
quantities.frame: natural-variable differentials only where Legendre coordinate maps are locally invertible

quantities.meaning: Boltzmann, Avogadro and molar gas constants; R=N_A k_B
quantities.status: exact defining SI constants and derived product
quantities.unit: J K^-1; mol^-1; J mol^-1 K^-1
quantities.frame: official 9th SI brochure values read at selected pages

quantities.status: exact defining SI constant and derived value

quantities.meaning: microstate energy; Hamiltonian; inverse thermal energy; partition sum/trace; normalized Gibbs state
quantities.unit: J; J-valued operator; J^-1; dimensionless; trace-one operator
quantities.frame: must match principal rest-frame energy or declare all additional energy modes

quantities.meaning: TGR rest-frame energy per particle with v=V/N_p, sigma=S/N_p
quantities.unit: J per particle; m^3 per particle; J K^-1 per particle
quantities.frame: includes its declared rest-energy reference; compare only after matching energy zeros and converting totals/mol quantities

quantities.meaning: local energy density, heat flux, conductivity tensor
quantities.frame: declared spatial/time domain and boundary conditions

frame_and_scope_guards: All principal macroscopic state functions use a declared center-of-mass rest-frame internal energy and fixed energy zero; external fields and nonzero bulk kinetic energy require an expanded balance.
The finite-volume CSM Hamiltonian includes center-of-mass kinetic energy unless the mode is fixed/removed, so CSM and this U are not automatically identical.
The TGR local specific energy includes rest energy; only a local conversion after unit/particle and energy-reference matching is licensed.
No relativistic temperature transformation is asserted.
The Nernst, Planck residual-entropy convention and operational unattainability statements are distinct; no equivalence without extra assumptions.
review_result: The repaired third-law definitions make the zero-boundary preparation set and protocol endpoint space explicit; the phase-rule inventory gives the regular local rank/dimension formula with its constraint-rank and interior assumptions. The audit does not infer empirical applicability.
